english_retrieval.title: Enjoy - Definition, Meaning & Synonyms
english_retrieval.snippet: # enjoy. To *enjoy* something is to take delight or pleasure in something: to have fun doing it. Whatever you like or love, you *enjoy*. Saying you enjoy something is a major compliment: it means you like it, and it makes you happy. Some people enjoy sports; others enjoy music. TV, movies, books, video games, sunny days, pets, and exercise are enjoyed by many people. We can also talk about enjoying as a type of advantage. A tall boxer enjoys an advantage because he has a longer reach than a short boxer. ### Vocabulary lists containing **enjoy**. view more about the vocabulary list.
